name: 36561 · Orange Beach, AL
findings: ZIP 36561 (Orange Beach) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 3 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2 organizations.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
